backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no methods defined.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping requested features to affected files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file listing brief descriptions of key frontend components, hooks, and styles.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global style layer defining light/dark OKLCH color variables and applying base styling.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Minimal App component rendering the ValentinePromptPage.
frontend/src/components/GifSlideshow.tsx: Component that cycles through GIFs on a timer with fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/ValentineSuccess: Success screen showing animated hearts, GIF slideshow, and custom love messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor instance tied to Internet Identity login state.
frontend/src/hooks/useEvasivePosition.ts: Hook that computes randomized safe positions for an evasive button.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication and state persistence.
frontend/src/index.css: Global styles including fonts, OKLCH color tokens, and custom animation keyframes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React entry point setting up query client, identity provider, and rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/ValentinePromptPage.t: React page showing a Valentine prompt where the Yes button grows with No clicks and switches to a success view when accepted.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, fonts, shadows, and animations with plugins and custom theme settings.
project_state.json: Project state describing requirements to rebuild a Valentine app with a GIF slideshow success screen and custom text.
